visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in a modern, dim restaurant setting featuring a large, glowing moon-shaped pendant lamp hanging over a marble table laden with various Japanese dishes, including sushi and sashimi platters. (2) A close-up shot focuses on a wooden tray containing 12 pieces of nigiri sushi; a hand holding black chopsticks picks up a raw shrimp nigiri to show the texture. (3) The camera pans over vibrant plates of raw marbled Wagyu beef, arranged artfully with green leaves and yellow flowers on wooden boards. (4) Slices of raw meat are placed on a round charcoal grill with hot coals; smoke rises as the meat sizzles. (5) A hand uses silver tongs to flip thin slices of beef on the grill, showing the transition from raw red to cooked brown. (6) Close-up shots show a cooked piece of Wagyu beef being held up, glistening with fat and juices. (7) Thick-cut beef tongue, stuffed with green onions, is grilled and then cut into bite-sized pieces with silver kitchen scissors on a blue plate. (8) A seafood platter with large raw prawns, crab legs, and scallops on ice is presented, followed by shots of these items being grilled and prepared. (9) Various side dishes are shown in rapid succession: a beef and fish roe sandwich, fried oysters, small bowls of appetizers, chawanmushi topped with scallops, and a bowl of fish soup. (10) Desserts including a bowl of warm purple rice porridge and a glass of milk-based shaved ice appear next to two colorful iced beverages. (11) The scene shifts to wide shots of the restaurant's interior, showing sleek dining booths, more moon lamps, and a clean, upscale aesthetic. (12) The final shot shows the restaurant's exterior at night with a glowing sign that reads 'CHING YUEH' and recruitment posters on the window.
